teams.product_capability: Doctrinal-lineage / citation-heritage navigation at full corpus scale: the ability to surface a decision's true legal ancestors and descendants (which precedents it follows, distinguishes, criticizes) as a separable citation-heritage map view, and to strengthen the citation-based primary representation and its evaluation.
teams.question: Can citation extraction + resolution be scaled from the current 250-decision graph sample (original_stats: total_decisions=250; 174 decisions with outgoing citations; 2,019/2,105 references resolved at 95.9%) to the full 174k corpus, producing a decision-to-decision citation graph with high coverage, and does that scaled graph (a) supply enough shared>=2 citation pairs to empirically validate or falsify the dense center_projected_64dim citation-heritage criterion (AUC>=0.75), and (b) improve the frozen TF-IDF primary citation-heritage AUC above 0.7296?
teams.hypothesis: The ACCEPTED evaluation retraction (2026-10-10) — all 174k dense citation-heritage runs FAILED with 'Insufficient valid pairs' and prior AUC 0.7667-0.8182 were retracted — is caused by the citation graph never being scaled beyond a 250-decision sample, not by a limitation of dense embeddings. Scaling the existing extraction/resolution pipeline to 174k will yield enough shared-citation pairs to make the citation-heritage criterion testable and will improve TF-IDF citation-heritage retrieval; if coverage stays low after scaling, the citation-heritage claim is genuinely dead and must remain retracted.
teams.why_now: Newer ACCEPTED evaluation evidence (core/evaluation/state/evaluation.json, EVAL_FREEZE_TFIDF_174K_BASELINE_20261010, 2026-10-10) explicitly names citation-graph coverage as the binding blocker for the citation-heritage capability and retracts the prior dense-superiority claim. The objective graph artifact (resolved_full/citation_graph_resolved.json, original_stats.total_decisions=250) confirms the graph is sample-scale. This is the single most concrete, product-relevant, accepted-evidence-backed bottleneck that is independent of the dense-embedding pipeline and of section extraction.
teams.non_duplication: Corpus lane (RUN) is chartered ONLY for 174k section extraction and the BGE/bger ID crosswalk — NOT citation-graph scaling. legal-distance is PAUSED and owns embedding/distance benchmarking, not graph construction; fractal-map owns clustering; evaluation owns the harness; product owns UI. No active lane or team currently builds a corpus-scale citation graph. The existing citation_resolver.py and the 250-decision resolved graph are used as the seed/validation baseline, not re-done.
dependencies: corpus/normalization/canonical pinned 174k corpus (bge_*/bger_* JSONL + parquet, full_text coverage 1.0, cited_decisions field coverage 0.526)
center_projected_64dim dense embeddings for the 2000-2021 subset (for dense citation-heritage validation)
frozen benchmark rule from core/evaluation/state/evaluation.json (citation-heritage threshold AUC>=0.75, shared>=2 citation pairs)
teams.acceptance_test: (1) Citation graph built at corpus scale with >=100k decisions carrying at least one resolved outgoing edge (or a documented, reproducible coverage ceiling explaining the limit); resolution rate reported against the 95.9% sample baseline. (2) Citation-heritage AUC on shared>=2 citation pairs computed on a held-out split, using the frozen harness, with >=2000 evaluable pairs. (3) EITHER frozen TF-IDF primary citation-heritage AUC improves above 0.7296 OR dense center_projected_64dim reaches the 0.75 criterion. (4) Artifacts serialized, deterministically reproducible, provenance-preserved. (5) Frozen benchmark NOT weakened; all negative results preserved.
teams.stop_promote_rule: PROMOTE (hand graph + metrics to fractal-map/legal-distance/evaluation/product as an accepted artifact) if acceptance (1)+(2) pass and (3) shows improvement or dense>=0.75. TERMINATE if the scaled graph cannot exceed ~10k decisions with resolved outgoing edges within the charter window, or if citation-heritage AUC does not exceed the frozen 0.7296 — record the negative result and leave the dense citation-heritage claim retracted. A successor hypothesis requires a NEW charter_version.

policy: Create specialized teams only for concrete product-relevant hypotheses or bottlenecks. Parallelism should grow with credible independent paths, not curiosity.
